title: Find election dates and results
summary: This page provides information on where to find election dates and results for local, state, and national levels in Australia.
intro:
In Australia, elections are held at local, state and national levels.

General elections and by-elections for the Parliament of New South Wales are managed by the NSW Electoral Commission (NSWEC). It also provides electoral services for a range of government, public and commercial organisations, including NSW local councils.

You can find state and local government election dates and past election results for NSW on the NSWEC website:

Federal government elections are managed by the Australian Electoral Commission (AEC).

You can find information about upcoming federal election dates and past election results on the AEC website.

faqs.q: Who manages elections for the Parliament of New South Wales?
faqs.a: The NSW Electoral Commission (NSWEC) manages general elections and by-elections for the Parliament of New South Wales.

faqs.q: Where can I find state and local government election dates and results for NSW?
faqs.a: You can find state and local government election dates and past election results for NSW on the NSWEC website.

faqs.q: Which body manages federal government elections?
faqs.a: The Australian Electoral Commission (AEC) manages federal government elections.
